title: SecondaryPanel React Component
description: Renders the source control panel with worktree and GitHub views, collapsible to a 34px strip showing the current branch.
params: props: SecondaryPanelProps (collapsed, branch, worktreeView, githubView, view, onSelectView, onToggleCollapse)
semantics: Renders panel header with view switcher (if multiple views available) and collapses to branch label when collapsed=true.
